title: Multiple thinking processes within terminal
body:
### What version of Codex is running?

0.1.2504172351

### Which model were you using?

04-mini

### What platform is your computer?

MacOS

### What steps can reproduce the bug?

When you open up another terminal while codex is processing a user query a loop of thinking lines seem to open up parallel to your own process. Not sure if this affects performance or what not but could be checked-out further. 

### What is the expected behavior?

We shouldn't see more than one process running in the terminal UI but we do see more than one, each time a terminal is opened, another process seems to loop in. 

### What do you see instead?

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f45851ff-f923-4ff0-b3c8-159b6facb73d)

### Additional information

_No response_

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue describes an agent workflow anomaly where multiple processes are running in parallel, causing unexpected repeated actions. This aligns with the definition of agent issues related to abnormal agent workflows.
